reasons: The cited text supports the compliant status: p0082 caps audits at once in any twelve-month period, requires thirty days' prior written notice, normal business hours, off-site where practicable, and an independent auditor bound by confidentiality — matching the preferred position on frequency, notice and conduct.

p0083 allocates audit cost to Vendor unless an underpayment exceeding five percent is established and expressly bars direct access to Customer systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material and third-party confidential information, satisfying the cost-allocation and no-system-access elements.
No redline or counterparty comment is expected or needed for a compliant finding; the proposal correctly leaves the paragraphs unchanged and adds no comment.

The deterministic check 'audit frequency limited: false' appears to be a false negative: the operative phrase 'no more than once in any twelve-month period' in p0082 is an express frequency cap, so the check does not undercut the compliance conclusion.

The rationale's assertions about Section 23 and the absence of other audit/monitoring rights are not contradicted by any supplied text and do not affect the compliant determination for the cited clause.
